# Arkion Push full-moon birth

An isolated random Pyreborne/Luna Coven campaign reached ring three after two
independently replayed wins. At deployment, the real player advisor could not
produce a complete continuation because the original Push Attack Arkion's
moon-tracked birth was guarded. Ending the initial turn reproduces the boundary.

The deployment starts on the new moon, but the moon advances before the boss
is created. Two original and two repaired independent native processes show the
13-attack, 425-health original boss created on the full moon with mask 6 and a
single fullmoon registration. Complete creation, placement, action, successor
and RNG comparisons pass. Four concurrent model runs and five altered moon,
identity, health, trigger and callback controls preserve the guard. The older
Arkion full-moon regression also passes. This does not establish ring-three
victory or campaign completion.
